title: Driver Idle Time Estimation
scenario: Calculate the average 'gap' between a driver's completed trip and their next pickup time.
tableSchema: trips (driver_id INT, pickup_time TIMESTAMP, dropoff_time TIMESTAMP)
hint: Use LEAD() on pickup_time and compare with current dropoff_time.
correctQuery: SELECT driver_id, AVG(pickup_time - dropoff_time) FROM (SELECT driver_id, pickup_time, dropoff_time, LEAD(pickup_time) OVER(PARTITION BY driver_id ORDER BY dropoff_time) as next_pickup FROM trips) t WHERE next_pickup IS NOT NULL GROUP BY driver_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE trips (driver_id INT, pickup_time TIMESTAMP, dropoff_time TIMESTAMP);
